sections.heading: Ecommerce AI SEO: questions, answered.

items.question: What is the difference between SEO and AI SEO?
items.answer: Traditional SEO aims for rankings in search results. AI SEO aims for your brand to be mentioned and linked in AI-generated answers. They share the same foundations, so we run them together.

items.question: Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend my store?
items.answer: No one controls AI answers, so no guarantees. We improve the signals AI assistants rely on and track how often you are cited over time.

items.question: Does structured data help with AI search?
items.answer: Yes. Complete product, offer and review schema makes it much easier for AI systems and Google to understand your products, prices and reputation.

items.question: Should I block AI crawlers on my Shopify store?
items.answer: Usually not if you want to be recommended. We review your robots.txt and decide together which crawlers to allow.

items.question: How do you measure AI SEO results?
items.answer: We track a fixed set of shopping prompts across major assistants, plus referral traffic from AI tools in your analytics.

items.question: Why use Klaviyo for a Shopify store?
items.answer: Klaviyo integrates deeply with Shopify, so you can segment and automate on real purchase data such as products bought, order value and predicted next order date.

items.question: Which email flows should every Shopify store have?
items.answer: At minimum: welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase and win-back. These form the foundation of retention revenue.

items.question: Can you migrate us from Mailchimp or another platform?
items.answer: Yes. We move your lists, consent data and templates, and rebuild your automations in Klaviyo.

items.question: How often should we send campaigns?
items.answer: It depends on your audience and product range. We test frequency by segment so engaged customers hear from you more often than less engaged ones.

items.question: Do you also manage SMS?
items.answer: Yes, through Klaviyo SMS, with consent handled correctly for each market.

sections.heading: Custom App Development: questions, answered.

items.question: When do I need a custom Shopify app?
items.answer: When no App Store app fits your workflow, when you are paying for several apps to do one job, or when you need to connect Shopify to an in-house system.

items.question: What is the difference between a private and a public app?
items.answer: A custom (private) app is built for one store only. A public app is listed on the Shopify App Store for any merchant to install and must pass Shopify’s review.

items.question: Can a custom app slow my store down?
items.answer: Not when it is built properly. We use Shopify Functions and theme app extensions, which run natively and load only where needed.

items.question: Who hosts and owns the app?
items.answer: You own the code. We can host it on your own cloud account or manage hosting for you.

items.question: How long does it take to build a Shopify app?
items.answer: Small Functions or integrations take a few weeks; larger apps with admin screens typically take 6–12 weeks.
